title: ID0469630-DC/Si-D/IT-[ MP / S9 170004060] Customer billed too much due to OCPP offline
description:
Reported Behaviour/ Issue: Customer was billed too much money due to the OCPP being offline, since there is some kind of blocking fee and the OCPP connection was only reestablished hours later, the OCPP calculated all those hours extra.
Solution: Logic in the backend should compromise when the OCPP goes offline, since you cannot know how much time they spent there after the session is finished, they should only bill the StopTransaction kWh.

additional_info.body:
Hello,
a client charged his car today 28 of December between 9:41:39 AM and 10:12:40 AM CU TIME (10:41:39 and 11:12:40 Italy time) and he says he left right after, but on our portal we see that the cable was disconnected at 1:01:34 PM CU TIME (14:01:34 Italy time), so he was charged a penalty because of it. Also, on the events of the charger we see that from this morning at 7:09 AM CU TIME the alarms "no error" and "CU up again" are constantly repeating.
Can you please check the logs?
Thank you
software version : v8.0.5-0-g33a6c1d

additional_info.subject: ID0469630-DC/Si-D/IT-[ MP / S9 170004060] CU Logs Check CRM:00263000321
additional_info.body:
Hello Rosita, good afternoon.
I checked the logs and at the point of the session stop, the OCPP connection was down but we are able to send the StopTransaction and it's received:
But the connector ID status is not transmitted due to connection offline:
Since we were never able to convey this information to the backend, only when it got the information, he processed it.
From our point of view, there should be a logic on the backend where if the connection is dropped, the customer only pays what is received in the StopTransaction, which was shared to the backend. Even for a complete offline scenario where we don't get the StopTransaction, as anyway, whenever the OCPP reestablishes the connection, the StopTransaction is sent regardless of the blocking fees, so the backend should obey that rule of, if OCPP offline, billing is the StopTransaction, as usually, only us can figure out how much time they stay there by checking the PilotState.
please let me know if this answered your questions and I can close the ticket.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
